title: Modal-Rectification-Based Directional Edge Diffusion for Cartesian Convection--Diffusion Problems
summary: Centered finite-difference discretizations of convection--diffusion equations may oscillate when convection dominates at the mesh scale. For homogeneous Dirichlet problems with constant coefficients on uniform Cartesian grids, we derive ADSC (Adaptive Directional Sparse Correction), a local directional edge-diffusion correction guided by modal rectification of the centered-stencil Fourier symbol.
